description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This full-time role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on patients' lives by assisting in the delivery of high-quality occupational therapy services.

As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain independence and improve their daily living skills. This position offers competitive hourly compensation and a supportive team environment focused on patient-centered care.
requirements: Current COTA license in the state of Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited COTA program
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, dedicated to providing exceptional patient care. We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to become a vital part of our therapy team. In this role, you will work collaboratively with Physical Therapists to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life.

This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate and the opportunity to make a significant impact on our patients' recovery journeys. If you are a compassionate and skilled PTA looking for a rewarding career in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in the state of Florida.
Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility is preferred.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

description: Are you a dedicated Speech-Language Pathologist seeking a rewarding full-time opportunity in Gainesville, FL? A premier health and rehabilitation center is looking for a passionate SLP to join their dynamic therapy team. This role offers the chance to make a significant impact on patients' lives, helping them regain communication and swallowing abilities in a supportive environment.You will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to develop and implement individualized treatment plans, ensuring the highest quality of care. This full-time position provides a competitive hourly rate and the opportunity to grow your career within a reputable healthcare setting.If you are committed to patient-centered care and eager to contribute your expertise, we encourage you to apply and become a vital part of a team dedicated to excellence in rehabilitation.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP)
Experience working in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $52.00, based on experience.

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL, as a Certified Dietary Manager. This facility, with a capacity of 55-59 beds and a current census of 43, offers a vibrant work environment. Located conveniently on a main street with abundant shopping nearby and a pleasant residential area behind, it's also just 15 minutes from the beach, providing an excellent work-life balance. The center features two courtyards, enhancing the resident and staff experience.

In this vital role, you will oversee all aspects of dietary services, ensuring the provision of high-quality, nutritious meals that meet the needs of our residents. You will manage daily operations, staff, and ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations. This is an opportunity to lead a dedicated team and make a significant impact on resident well-being in a supportive setting.

We are seeking a proactive and compassionate leader to maintain our high standards of care. This position offers 8-hour shifts and a competitive annual salary. If you are passionate about dietary management in a healthcare setting and thrive in a community-focused environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Certified Dietary Manager (CDM) certification
Proven experience in food service management, preferably within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong understanding of nutritional needs, special diets, and dietary regulations
Ability to lead and manage a team effectively
Excellent communication and organizational skills

description:
